# 1. Scrape weekly plan function
def get_weekly_plan(plan_number):
    url = f"https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/meal-plan-{plan_number}/" #specify the link of meal plan
    headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"} #avoid any blocks frmo the website
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers) # format for web scrapping
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser') # beautifulsoup: It transforms the HTML code into a Python object that is very easy to search and navigate.

    days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday'] #list of all days
    recipes = [] #empty list to store the recipies
    #use for loop to find the matches
    for day in days:
        pattern = re.compile(rf'{day}: (.+?) \$(\d+\.?\d*)', re.IGNORECASE) # matches extract recipe names and prices
        for match in pattern.finditer(soup.get_text()):
            recipe_name = match.group(1).strip() #column 1 with recipie names
            price = float(match.group(2)) #columns 2 qith prices
            link = "" #emplty string for links
            for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
                if recipe_name.lower() in a.text.lower():
                    link = a["href"]
                    break 
            recipes.append({
                "Day of the Week": day,
                "Name of Recipe": recipe_name,
                "Link to Recipe": link,
                "Price of Recipe": price
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

    url = "https://tasty.p.rapidapi.com/recipes/list"
    headers = {

    # Extract recipes from API results

    for r in data.get('results', []):
        recipes.append({
            "Tasty Title": r.get('name'),
            "Tasty ID": r.get('id'),
            "Tasty URL": r.get('canonical_id'),
            "Tasty Description": r.get("description"),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

# 3. Automated integration function
def get_mealplan_data(plan_number):
    weekly_df = get_weekly_plan(plan_number)
    all_results = []
    for idx, row in weekly_df.iterrows():
        recipe_name = row['Name of Recipe']
        tasty_df = match_recipe(recipe_name)

            recipe_name = match.group(1).strip()
            price = float(match.group(2))

                    break
            recipes.append({

# 2. API query function for one recipe
def match_recipe(recipe_name):
    url = "https://tasty.p.rapidapi.com/recipes/list"
    headers = {
        "X-RapidAPI-Key": "d862f7cf28msh3be5a9a6c442deep1a2ac9jsn7b3a879fcbde",
        "X-RapidAPI-Host": "tasty.p.rapidapi.com"
    }
    querystring = {"from": "0", "size": "100", "q": recipe_name}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=querystring)
    data = response.json()
    recipes = []
    for r in data.get('results', []):
        recipes.append({
            "Tasty Title": r.get('name'),
            "Tasty ID": r.get('id'),
            "Tasty URL": r.get('canonical_id'),
            "Tasty Description": r.get("description"),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

# 3. Only automate for Monday (or any specific day you want)
def get_mealplan_data(plan_number, day='Monday'):
    weekly_df = get_weekly_plan(plan_number)
    monday_df = weekly_df[weekly_df["Day of the Week"].str.lower() == day.lower()]
    all_results = []
    for idx, row in monday_df.iterrows():
        recipe_name = row['Name of Recipe']
        tasty_df = match_recipe(recipe_name)
        tasty_df['Day of the Week'] = row['Day of the Week']
        tasty_df['Original Recipe Name'] = recipe_name
        tasty_df['Original Link'] = row['Link to Recipe']
        tasty_df['Original Price'] = row['Price of Recipe']
        all_results.append(tasty_df)
    if all_results:
        return pd.concat(all_results, ignore_index=True)
    else:
        return pd.DataFrame()  # Return empty dataframe if no matches

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
import re

def get_weekly_plan(plan_number):
    url = f"https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/meal-plan-{plan_number}/"
    headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')
    text = soup.get_text()
    # Debug print for actual meal lines
    print("==== Extracted relevant lines ====")
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if ':' in line and '$' in line:
            print(line.strip())
    recipes = []
    days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday']
    for day in days:
        pattern = re.compile(rf'{day}:\s*(.+?)\s*\$(\d+\.?\d*)', re.IGNORECASE)
        found = False
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            found = True
            recipe_name = match.group(1).strip()
            price = float(match.group(2))
            recipes.append({
                "Day of the Week": day,
                "Name of Recipe": recipe_name,
                "Price of Recipe": price
            })
        print(f"Found recipe for {day}: {found}")
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

```{python}
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
import re

def get_weekly_plan(plan_number):
    url = f"https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/meal-plan-{plan_number}/"
    headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)"}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')
    text = soup.get_text()
    days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday']
    recipes = []
    for day in days:
        pattern = re.compile(rf'{day}:\s*(.+?)\s*\$(\d+\.?\d*)', re.IGNORECASE)
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            recipe_name = match.group(1).strip()
            price = float(match.group(2))
            link = ""
            for a in soup.find_all('a', href=True):
                if recipe_name.lower() in a.text.lower():
                    link = a['href']
                    break
            recipes.append({
                "Day of the Week": day,
                "Name of Recipe": recipe_name,
                "Link to Recipe": link,
                "Price of Recipe": price
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

def match_recipe(recipe_name):
    url = "https://tasty.p.rapidapi.com/recipes/list"
    headers = {
        "X-RapidAPI-Key": "d862f7cf28msh3be5a9a6c442deep1a2ac9jsn7b3a879fcbde",
        "X-RapidAPI-Host": "tasty.p.rapidapi.com"
    }
    querystring = {"from": "0", "size": "100", "q": recipe_name}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=querystring)
    data = response.json()
    recipes = []
    for r in data.get('results', []):
        recipes.append({
            "Tasty Title": r.get('name'),
            "Tasty ID": r.get('id'),
            "Tasty URL": r.get('canonical_id'),
            "Tasty Description": r.get("description"),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

def get_mealplan_data(plan_number):
    weekly_df = get_weekly_plan(plan_number)
    # Only keep Monday rows
    monday_df = weekly_df[weekly_df["Day of the Week"].str.lower() == "monday"] #only for mondays
    all_results = []
    for idx, row in monday_df.iterrows():
        recipe_name = row['Name of Recipe']
        tasty_df = match_recipe(recipe_name)
        if not tasty_df.empty:
            tasty_df['Day of the Week'] = row['Day of the Week']
            tasty_df['Original Recipe Name'] = recipe_name
            tasty_df['Original Link'] = row['Link to Recipe']
            tasty_df['Original Price'] = row['Price of Recipe']
            all_results.append(tasty_df)
        else:
            all_results.append(pd.DataFrame({
                "Day of the Week": [row['Day of the Week']],
                "Original Recipe Name": [recipe_name],
                "Original Link": [row['Link to Recipe']],
                "Original Price": [row['Price of Recipe']]
            }))
    if all_results:
        final_df = pd.concat(all_results, ignore_index=True)
        return final_df
    else:
        return pd.DataFrame()  # Empty if nothing found

df = get_mealplan_data(202)
df

```{python}
def match_recipe(recipe_name):
    url = "https://tasty.p.rapidapi.com/recipes/list"
    headers = {
        "X-RapidAPI-Key": "d862f7cf28msh3be5a9a6c442deep1a2ac9jsn7b3a879fcbde",
        "X-RapidAPI-Host": "tasty.p.rapidapi.com"
    }
    querystring = {"from": "0", "size": "100", "q": recipe_name}
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=querystring)
    data = response.json()
    recipes = []
    for r in data.get('results', []):
        nutrition = r.get("nutrition") or {}
        recipes.append({
            "Tasty Title": r.get('name'),
            "Calories": nutrition.get("calories"),
            "Protein": nutrition.get("protein"),
            "Fat": nutrition.get("fat"),
            "Carbs": nutrition.get("carbohydrates"),
            "Tasty ID": r.get('id'),
            "Tasty URL": r.get('canonical_id'),
            "Tasty Description": r.get("description"),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(recipes)

## analyse extra part


```{python}
##### Pick the best Tasty match per day with nutrition info:
```{python}
# Ensure you work with your nutrition DataFrame from start to finish
df_with_cal = df_with_cal.dropna(subset=['Calories'])  # keep only rows with nutrition info

# Sort and pick one best row per weekday (highest calories, or whatever you want)
df_with_cal = df_with_cal.sort_values(['Day of the Week', 'Calories'], ascending=[True, False])
best_per_day = df_with_cal.groupby('Day of the Week', as_index=False).first()

```

##### Compute Macros as % of Calories
```{python}
# Ensure numeric
for macro in ['Protein', 'Fat', 'Carbs']:
    best_per_day[macro] = pd.to_numeric(best_per_day[macro], errors='coerce')

best_per_day['kcal_protein'] = best_per_day['Protein'] * 4
best_per_day['kcal_fat']     = best_per_day['Fat'] * 9
best_per_day['kcal_carbs']   = best_per_day['Carbs'] * 4

best_per_day['kcal_total_from_macros'] = best_per_day[['kcal_protein','kcal_fat','kcal_carbs']].sum(axis=1)
best_per_day['pct_protein'] = best_per_day['kcal_protein'] / best_per_day['kcal_total_from_macros'] * 100
best_per_day['pct_fat']     = best_per_day['kcal_fat'] / best_per_day['kcal_total_from_macros'] * 100
best_per_day['pct_carbs']   = best_per_day['kcal_carbs'] / best_per_day['kcal_total_from_macros'] * 100

```

```{python}
if 'Vegetarian' not in best_per_day.columns:
    # If you still have 'Name of Recipe', use that
    # otherwise switch to 'Tasty Title'
    if 'Name of Recipe' in best_per_day.columns:
        best_per_day['Vegetarian'] = best_per_day['Name of Recipe'].apply(is_vegetarian)
    elif 'Tasty Title' in best_per_day.columns:
        best_per_day['Vegetarian'] = best_per_day['Tasty Title'].apply(is_vegetarian)

```
##### Melt to long format for plotnine

```{python}

bp_long = best_per_day.melt(
    id_vars=['Day of the Week','Vegetarian','Tasty Title'],
    value_vars=['pct_protein','pct_fat','pct_carbs'],
    var_name='Macro', value_name='Percent'
)
bp_long['Macro'] = bp_long['Macro'].map({
    'pct_protein': 'Protein',
    'pct_fat': 'Fat',
    'pct_carbs': 'Carbs'
})

# Ensure correct weekday order
